title: Vial Logic: Potion Sort Alchemy
core_loop: Player sorts volatile potion essences into uniform vials by decanting between them. Each move: tap a source vial, then tap a destination vial — the top contiguous layer of matching essence pours over if the destination has space and matches (or is empty). Core loop: scan rack -> identify decant that advances essence grouping -> execute pour -> repeat until every non-empty vial holds exactly 4 units of a single essence. Pure logic, no timing, no dexterity — instant reset on mistake. Special rule: opposing essences (Fire/Water, Air/Earth) cannot occupy the same vial — they react violently and must be separated first.
controls: Mouse/touch only. Tap a vial to select it (glowing rune highlight). Tap a second vial to decant from first into second. Invalid decant (wrong essence, no space, empty source, opposing essence conflict) triggers vial shudder + rune flash and clears selection. Tap selected vial again to deselect. Reset button restarts level instantly. No drag, hold, or swipe — purely two-tap discrete actions.
mechanics: 6 vertical vials, capacity 4 each. 4 essences × 4 units = 16 units total, plus 2 empty vials = 6 vials on screen. Essences: Crimson Fire (red), Azure Water (blue), Amber Air (gold), Verdant Earth (green)

Decant rule: only the top contiguous layer of a single essence moves. Destination must be empty or have same essence on top. Destination must have free capacity. Partial decants allowed (e.g., 3 Fire on top, dest has 1 space -> moves 1 Fire)

OPPOSING ESSENCE CONFLICT: Fire and Water cannot coexist in same vial. Air and Earth cannot coexist in same vial. Attempting to pour Fire into Water-top vial (or vice versa) triggers violent reaction: vial flashes, shakes violently, pour cancels, both essences briefly display warning sigils. Same for Air/Earth
Move counter: 25 moves max (tighter than v1 due to conflict constraint). Counter decrements on every successful decant. Turns amber at ≤5 moves remaining
Session timer: 75 seconds (longer to accommodate conflict planning). Thin alchemical progress bar at top with essence-symbol markers. Timer expiry = loss

Level generation: 16 units (4 per essence) shuffled and dealt into first 4 vials (4 each). Last 2 vials start empty. Generation ensures solvable state by avoiding impossible Fire/Water or Air/Earth deadlocks in initial deal
Solved state: every non-empty vial contains exactly 4 units of identical essence (i.e., 4 uniform vials, 2 empty). All opposing pairs successfully separated
No undo, no hints, no move preview. Pure player deduction with added spatial reasoning for conflict avoidance
Difficulty scaling not in MVP — single board layout. Future: 5th essence (Aether, neutral), catalyzed reactions (Fire+Air=Lightning), unstable vials that leak over time, move-optimal targets
juice: Vial frame: ornate brass-banded glass with etched rune corresponding to contained essence (glows when essence matches rune, dim when empty/mismatched)
Essence layers: gradient-filled liquid with subtle parallax swirl animation (distinct per essence: Fire=upward flame wisps, Water=downward ripples, Air=horizontal drift, Earth=slow sediment settling)
Decant animation: selected essence layer rises as ethereal stream in 220ms with gentle S-curve, destination essence settles with 120ms viscous rebound (Juice.ParticleBurst with essence-tinted motes)
Successful decant: 8-particle essence-matched burst at vial mouth (Fire=ember motes, Water=droplets, Air=wind spirals, Earth=crystal shards) + resonant chime (pentatonic, distinct pitch per essence)

Opposing conflict: vial shudders 120ms 0.008 intensity (Juice.ScreenShake), both essences flare warning sigils (Fire/Water=steam explosion, Air/Earth=thunderclap), pour cancels with reversed stream animation
Vial selection: expanding brass-gold rune ring (Juice.GemSelectionHighlight) around vial bands, matching essence rune pulses brighter
Move counter: alchemical numeral display, shifts from gold to amber at ≤5 moves, rune flickers on decrement
Timer bar: mercury-filled capillary tube, silver meniscus recedes leftward; essence symbols glow as milestones pass; flashes crimson at <20% remaining
Level start: 'SEPARATE THE OPPOSING ESSENCES' illuminated manuscript banner slides down (Juice.IntroBanner), tap hint on first vial with essence rune fades after 3s

Win: all 4 uniform vials illuminate in sequence (200ms stagger), essence motes ascend into unified sigil (Juice.ParticleBurst radial), victory fanfare (pentatonic ascending arpeggio), GameOverPanel with 'TRANSMUTATION COMPLETE', move count as purity score, retry button
Loss (moves/timer): crimson vignette flash + sharp shake (10px) + dissonant tritone, GameOverPanel with 'ESSENCES UNSTABLE' or 'HOURGLASS EMPTY', move count as purity score, retry button
Background: aged parchment texture with subtle alchemical diagram watermark, candle-light flicker parallax on pointer move (Juice.ParallaxBackground)

Audio: all procedural Web Audio — decant (filtered liquid pour), essence chimes (FM synthesis), conflict (ring modulation), win (additive synthesis arpeggio), fail (subtractive dissonance), ambient (crackling fire + water drip loop)
mvp_scope: Single 800×450 canvas. 6 vials, 4 essences (2 opposing pairs), capacity 4, 25 moves, 75s timer. All graphics procedural: vials as brass-banded rounded rects with etched runes, essences as animated gradient layers with parallax swirl. Physics-free — instant discrete decants with S-curve streaming. Level data: single board generated on start via constrained shuffle (avoids initial deadlocks). Juice toolkit for particles, highlights, banners, panels, screen shake, parallax, procedural audio. Zero external assets. Single self-contained HTML file with vendored Phaser 3 + Juice. Target 60fps on 7-year-old phones. Responsive: letterboxed on mobile, centered on desktop.
win_lose_condition: WIN: All 4 essences sorted into 4 uniform vials (4 units each, same essence), 2 vials empty. All opposing pairs (Fire/Water, Air/Earth) successfully separated. Triggers win sequence: vial illumination cascade, unified sigil mote ascent, ascending arpeggio fanfare, GameOverPanel with 'TRANSMUTATION COMPLETE', move count as purity score, retry button. LOSE: Move counter reaches 0 OR 75s timer expires. Triggers loss sequence: crimson vignette, sharp shake, dissonant tritone, GameOverPanel with 'ESSENCES UNSTABLE' (moves) or 'HOURGLASS EMPTY' (timer), move count as purity score, retry button. No meta-progression, no stars, no lives — pure single-board alchemical puzzle.
